value.rationale: The 2021 paper establishes qualitative intermingled basins but has no quantitative random basin law. Exact separator marginals determine three expected attraction-basin fractions for all beta, and strict negative dependence rules out independent-basin approximations, a motivated nontrivial joint observable of the common chaotic forcing. The bound is uniform in all interior thresholds and a signed covariance series enables systematic quantitative refinement.
